svg.title: Two plans from the same start: a straight line that falls short, and a curve worked back from the vision that reaches it.
svg.desc: Two lines over the same time, both starting from today at the lower left. The vision sits at the upper right, highlighted, and a dotted arrow runs back from it to today: worked back from it. The first line, planned step by step, climbs in a straight line and ends, on time, about halfway up. The gap between its end and the vision is shaded: still short. The second, planned from the destination, stays low at first, while new investments take time to come online, then climbs steeply and reaches the vision.
svg.text: new investments take time to come online
